attack_plan.narrative: Reports of Putin’s disappearance have raised concerns about a potential palace coup, particularly after the Kremlin released a photo of Putin and Obama together, which some speculate might be a diversionary tactic. The absence of Putin has coincided with increased tensions with NATO and growing political unrest within Russia. Additionally, the sudden absence of high-profile media figures like Brian Williams and Bill O'Reilly, who have previously discussed Putin’s fate, adds to the mystery. The situation remains fluid, with many questioning whether Putin’s return to public life will signal the end of a coup or simply a strategic move to regain control. Notably, white smoke has been observed above the Kremlin, leading some to speculate about a new leader being chosen. As the world watches, the possibility of a palace coup looms large.
